timeout_policy: Total 150 seconds includes queue, Embedding and generation. Supersedes the historical 60-second mixed run; TPOT SLO remains 100ms.
capacity_definition: SLO-constrained validated rate; average queue growth is observed but is not a pass gate. This is not a claim of stationary queues.
supplementary_policy: This run uses only the three frozen mixed workload classes. Any further workload requires a separate configuration and run.
stop_policy: Stop benchmark load on frozen worker/container/process identity change, stale telemetry, OOM, client saturation, stop file, or unexpired residual requests. Never restart model services.
execution_mode: Ascend AWQ ACL graph and both Iluvatar AWQ nodes FULL decode graph; MUSA V0 eager with standard MCCL and SHM enabled after graph concurrency incompatibility. Mixed-mode system capacity, not a graph-mode vendor comparison. Each awq request first executes Embedding on separate .58 devices; pooling graph replay is not established.
scope: Full pipeline: actual Embedding, then uniform random selection among healthy vendor pools, then a pool-specific official vLLM cache_aware Router with zero absolute imbalance threshold and relative threshold 1.0 selects one AWQ instance. No model service/container replacement; no CPU/memory/PID limits.
